column1: # The 0.46c2 guns' textures that get an _aoac (../weapon-camo/weapon_camo.py, its guns.tsv format:
# texture, donors (none: no premium copies), the model surfaces whose UVs use it). Made from the pack's
# models (surfaces of sights, barrels, muzzle devices and rounds left out, as guns.tsv leaves them).
# The sights, barrels, muzzle brakes and rounds get a mask that paints nothing (parts.tsv: no part,
# weapon_camo.py --bare-masks), so a camouflaged gun finds every surface's _aoac and they stay bare.
